job: the gadget: raw capability, a hybrid universe-simulator machine in the spirit of The Midnight Gospel, familiar parts in an impossible whole, organic and mechanical at once; not a device with buttons, not an orb; its dial is the one emitter; hand-coded today in Gadget.tsx

prompt.common: Create ONE design variant sheet for a prop of a silent hand-drawn animated film. Pure black field (#000000), flat shapes in five roles only (main1, main2, shadow, light, accent), thin pale contour one step lighter than each fill with tapered tips, shadow as a designed shape with two-scale stipple (never a smooth gradient), no text, no labels, no UI, no gradients, no photographic texture, no black outline. Colour script of the shot: deep blues with cream light and one scarce yellow accent #fad204 (radiance blue #0a51fb). The design must separate into movable parts on the black field (each part a closed flat shape) so it can be cut and moved later.
